question: In which country was the Theosophical Society founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**America**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• America **founded ****the Theosophical Society.**
 
• The Theosophical Society was officially formed in New York City, United States, on 17 November 1875 by Helena Petrovna Blavatsky, Colonel Henry Steel Olcott, William Quan Judge, and others.
 
• It was self-described as "an unsectarian body of seekers after Truth, who endeavour to promote Brotherhood and strive to serve humanity."
 
• Theosophy is derived from the Greek word ‘theosophical meaning "God's wisdom".
 
• Theosophy was a philosophy combining mysticism and spiritualism (with heavy influences from Buddhist and Hindu thought) with metaphysics.
 
• The Society was fashioned as a 'brotherhood' promoting unity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **In India****​**

 
 
• Adyar __was the headquarters of the Theosophical Society established in India.
 
• In 1882, the headquarters of the Society were established in Adyar, near Madras (now Chennai) in India.
 
• Theosophy was a philosophy combining mysticism and spiritualism (with heavy influences from Buddhist and Hindu thought) with metaphysics.
 
• The Society was fashioned as a 'brotherhood' promoting unity.
 
• The Society was also concerned with preparing the world for the coming of the 'World Teacher' when he arrived on Earth.
 
• The movement was popularised by Annie Besant in India.
 
• The Society accepted the Hindu beliefs in reincarnation, Karma and drew inspi­ration from the philosophy of the Upanishads and Samkhya, Yoga, and Vedanta Schools of thought.
